scenario: Ask a station worker for help using public transit: locate the subway entrance, ask where to buy a ticket, find a platform, check whether a train goes to Seoul Station, ask where to transfer, and ask which exit to use for a named destination. State destinations and context clearly without asserting real route information. Keep the final exit question as the hard beginner comment bonus.
audience: English-speaking adults learning practical beginner Korean for travel
level: Beginner: two easy location questions, two medium service or destination questions, two harder transfer or exit questions
